module: 'Prop Transformer' window of the live Vehicle Editor: lets you choose a prop (visual part such as a mirror or a lamp) of the vehicle by aiming at its reference node ('Pick Prop', wheel to cycle through overlapping props) then modify its transformation live: baseTranslation, baseTranslationGlobal (m), baseRotation, baseRotationGlobal (displayed in degrees, converted to radians for the engine), either by numeric fields or with the axis gizmo. The values "without nodeRotate/Offset/Move" can be copied to the clipboard in the JSON format "x":…, "y":…, "z":… to paste them into the jbeam.
notes: The changes only apply to the live session; the values must be copied back into the jbeam.
The clipboard values ignore the node transformations (nodeRotate/nodeOffset/nodeMove): they are those of the original jbeam.
Rotations are entered in degrees (EnterReturnsTrue fields: confirmed with Enter) but stored in radians on the engine side.
State kept per vehicle ID (copy of vehData); onVehicleSpawned deletes it and recreates it.
Uses the same gizmos as nodeTransformer (setAxisGizmoRenderPlane, MoveGrid, PlaneHashes).

onVehicleEditorRenderJBeams.desc: Render hook emitted by editor_veMain: initializes the state if needed, draws the chosen prop, applies the transformation via the gizmo and runs the prop picking (mode 2).

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: draws the window (Pick Prop button, translation/rotation fields, copy and gizmo buttons).

onVehicleSwitched.desc: On vehicle change, switches to the state of the new vehicle.

onVehicleSpawned.desc: When a vehicle spawns, forgets then recreates its state.
